pages: ADDENDUM TO DIAGNOSTIC MANUAL 10000041488 PIN-OUT CHART On page 252 of the diagnostic manual, J1-1 should be wire number 11S Generator Voltage Sensing J1-2 should be wire number 44S Generator Voltage Sensing. J1-19 should be wire number 86 Low Oil Pressure and J1-20 should be wire number 85 High Temperature Shutdown. The wiring diagrams are correct.
